note: The expressions _benedicens benedicam_ (blessing I shall bless) and _multiplicans multiplicabo_ (multiplying I shall multiply) – stylistically to be explained as figura etymologica (see above, Chapter 8.7) – are “strange in Latin.” – George C. Richards: _A Concise Dictionary to the Vulgate New Testament_. London 1934 (xvi, 130 pp.), p. xii.
